description_en: Queries the model configuration details of a cloud computer
description_zh: 查询云电脑模型配置详情
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center get-runtime-model-config --runtime-type CloudDesktop --runtime-id ecd-xxxx --agent-platform ENTERPRISE --agent-provider OpenClaw --include-risk-info true --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetRuntimeModelConfig

parameters.description_en:
The Agent runtime ID. The ID mappings are as follows:

JVS Computer: JVS Computer ID, in the format of jvs-xxxx.

OpenClaw: Cloud computer ID, in the format of ecd-xxxx.

Hermes Agent: Hermes Agent ID, in the format of jvs-xxxx.
parameters.description_zh:

Hermes Agent：Hermes Agent ID，格式如 jvs-xxxx。
